name: Desert Fish Habitat Partnership annual project funding
summary: Annual National Fish Habitat Partnership funding for on-the-ground habitat restoration, barrier work and assessments that conserve native desert fishes in the southwestern US. Typical awards are $5k-$50k.

geography.label: Lower Colorado, Upper Colorado, Rio Grande and Basin and Range regions

steps: DFHP Steering Committee review and ranking

eligibility.rule: The project is not a research project
The project includes an outreach/education component
The project falls under at least one NFHP National Conservation Priority
The project is completed within 18–24 months of the 2027 contract agreement
Acquisition projects have approval from the appropriate state agency in the project state

documents: Letters of support from relevant agencies and Tribal governments
Landowner consent letter, if the project is on private land

status.quote: Completed proposal applications must be submitted no later than 5 PM Pacific Time on October 2, 2026.

deadline.quote: Completed proposal applications must be submitted no later than 5 PM Pacific Time on October 2, 2026.

geography.quote: welcome from all four DFHP geographic regions (Lower Colorado, Upper Colorado, Rio Grande, and Basin and Range)

access.quote: Proposal packages should be submitted by email to jon.sjoberg@wafwa.org.

window.quote: NFHP project funding from The ACE Act is authorized annually through the US Fish and Wildlife Service

amount.quote: Typical funding per project is within the range of $5k-$50k

effort.quote: Applications must be received by 5PM Pacific Time, Friday, October 2, 2026.

The DFHP Steering Committee will review and rank applications based on their ability to meet the partnership's key priorities, strategic objectives (see the DFHP Strategic Plan), and other NFHP and ACE Act requirements.
The ranked project proposals are then submitted to the NFHP Board for their approval.
A list of the Board approved projects for all FHPs nationwide is then submitted to the US Department of Interior (DOI) for final approval.

eligibility.quote: Funds may not be used for research projects.
All NFHP funded projects must include an outreach/education component.
FY27 project proposals must fall under at least one of the NFHP National Conservation Priorities.
Funded projects must be completed within 18-24 months of receipt of contract agreement in 2027
All real property acquisition projects funded with NFHP funds must be approved by the appropriate state agency in the state in which the project is occurring.

after_award.quote: provide interim and annual reports to the USFWS and DFHP.

documents.quote: The Budget Template Worksheet, and 3) The Project Metrics Summary Worksheet
Include at least one photo that will be used as the main photo for project-related materials.

Project proposals must be supported by letters from state and/or federal fish and wildlife management/natural resource agencies as well as the appropriate land management agency (if on public lands) or Tribal governments within project-area jurisdictions. In addition, if project is located on private land, a landowner consent letter is needed.
